meta.description: Canonical content for the Go checkpoint tester: one directory per exercise, holding the subject, the official test, the reference solution and a generated starter.
meta.levelModel: level belongs to the placement, not the exercise

tests.note: The exam nodes name ghcr.io/01-edu/test-go; that repository is a stale go1.18 build. module-go is the image actually in service.

placementSource.note: Four checkpoints are piscine exams; the final one is a module exam, so there is no single root to walk. tools/go-exams.py holds the rule both the fetch and the build use.

graphql.note: raw object / object_child rows — authoritative for level, order, category, expectedFiles and allowedFunctions

resolved.note: the platform's rendered tree — authoritative for the values it computes: baseXp, difficulty, subject path, tester image, cooldown

crossCheck.note: every structural field is compared between the two sources at build time; the build fails on any disagreement
